title: umetate node manifest
description: A reusable DSP primitive: typed ports, a params interface, a state manifest, and a static-inline dsp core. One node = one algorithm; shape/spectrum/envelope = data. Ports may carry a numeric format (q15/q16/q32/phase) alongside the rate, so the generator can reject e.g. Q16 control -> Q32 phase. See docs/roadmap.md §3.1, §12.5.

note_derived.description: default field -> frequency ratio; at note-on, field = note_to_inc(note) * ratio (a macro param overrides it).

note_cutoff.description: field -> ratio; at note-on, field = 2*sin(pi * note_to_inc * ratio / 2^32), the Q16 SVF coefficient for a note-tracked filter.

note_reciprocal.description: field -> source state; at note-on, field = 2^32 / source (the note-derived increment's reciprocal, for polyBLEP).

note_tune.description: field -> [octave, semi, cent] param names; at note-on, field = note_to_inc(note) * 2^(octave + semi/12 + cent/1200) (fm1_tune_q16).

block_derived.description: field -> template; recomputed once per control block (before the audio loop), e.g. the phasor's pitch-scaled increment.

default.description: a C expression for an unconnected input (e.g. voice_gate[v])
